intent_contract.text: 첨부한 이미지의 외모에 어울리는 주사기를 든 얀데레 간호사 컨셉 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성해줘.
첨부한 이미지는 얼굴만 참고하고 구도는 자유롭게 해줘.

Create a photorealistic adult yandere-nurse character portrait whose sweetness and possessiveness are simultaneously legible, using the attached image only to guide the face while allowing a new composition.

Create a photorealistic cinematic photograph of an adult woman working as a hospital nurse; use the attached reference image for her face only, closely preserving her pale-blonde hair, soft oval features, wide gray-brown eyes, straight brows, small nose, and glossy rose lips. Present her as obsessively affectionate yet unnervingly possessive in an after-hours treatment room, holding a capped medical syringe beside her cheek without touching anyone. Her gentle bedside smile and unwavering eye contact suggest tender devotion slipping into controlled menace. Prioritize faithful facial resemblance, expressive eyes, and the contradiction between clinical care and restrained danger. Use a clean white uniform, natural skin texture, cool fluorescent light cut by a faint red monitor glow, and shallow depth of field. No blood, no injury, no injection, no text, no watermark.

Grooming, posture, and facial baseline retain a carefully controlled public-facing surface.
A restrained affect leak is visibly readable around the eyes, mouth, or breath without melodramatic collapse.
One interrupted self-regulation or connection gesture is visibly unfinished rather than merely described.
Controlled surface, affect leak, and interrupted gesture coexist on the same character in the same moment.
The image reads as a specific three-part affective contradiction, not merely gothic fashion, a sad gaze, or a decorative prop.
The user's requested role, fashion, and reference-face use remain intact and are not replaced by the affective profile.
No diagnosis text, acute crisis staging, medicalized distress, self-harm cue, or sexualized vulnerability substitutes for the requested meaning.
